senses.zh_definition: 若指 Carla，则为女性人名，可音译为卡拉；输入中的小写 carla 尚无法确认为马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: If intended as Carla, a feminine given name; the lowercase input is not verified as a Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Jika yang dimaksudkan ialah Carla, nama khas perempuan; bentuk carla dalam input belum dapat disahkan sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu.

etymology.historical_story: Carla belongs to a European personal-name tradition: the Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources identifies it as a feminine form of Charles. That supports interpreting Carla as a name, but does not identify the lowercase token in this packet. No Malay lexical origin or ordinary dictionary meaning can be established from the supplied evidence.
